title: feat: complete verification packs and persisted arena evidence
body:
## P2 — Verification, packs, Docker boundary, and statistics

Stacked on PR #17 (`completion/core-arena`).

- expands bounded objective verifiers and immutable policy evidence
- adds deterministic seeded official-pack materialization with persistence
- marks programming cases Docker-required with no host fallback
- persists Arena repetition summaries, uncertainty, tie margins, and sample evidence
- adds usable pack materialization, Arena summary history, and Docker-blocked UI states
- validates with Vitest, TypeScript build, boundary fixtures, Rust fmt/check/tests

P2 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView QA and remote CI.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
